Electricity generation by source, 1985 to 2025

Source: R/data.R
electricity_mix.Rd

How much of each country's electricity was generated from each of nine sources, every year from 1985 to 2025. Each row is one source in one country and year. A row is included only when the source's share was reported, so coverage varies: about 80 countries have data before 2000, about 200 from 2000 to 2024, and about 90 for 2025.

Usage

electricity_mix

Format

A data frame with 54,663 rows and 5 columns:

country

Country name, or "World" for the world total.

year

Year.

source

Source of electricity: "coal", "gas", "oil", "nuclear", "hydro", "wind", "solar", "bioenergy" or "other renewables" (geothermal, wave and tidal power).

generation

Electricity generated from the source, in terawatt-hours (TWh).

share

Percentage of the country's electricity generated from the source.

Source

Our World in Data, energy dataset, https://github.com/owid/energy-data, based on Ember's Yearly Electricity Data and the Energy Institute's Statistical Review of World Energy. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
